collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS - LIVING CULTURE X: GROWING UP, GROWING OLD AND EVERYDAY JOY (LCJ-01..50, draft, 2026-11-18)
The rest of the owner's 100 Living Culture ideas and the world-inspired 50: secret languages and forgotten words, coming of age, elders who will not retire, healers' oaths, failed discoveries, masks and clothes and masterpieces nobody wanted, talent shows, ridiculous hats and the day nobody worked.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. The owner waived the review ("I'm sure the draft events are fine"); every event passed the Isola rules and the final 15-point review, logged in the notes.

collection.description: Families gather to repair the terraces and the water channels together, then celebrate: work first, or start with a song.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Today is the community workday: every family repairs the hillside terraces and the water channels together, and afterwards there is a celebration of many generations, with the old songs and the new ones. (subject) wants to start with a song to warm everyone up. (friend) wants to get to work before the sun is high. What should they do?

text_only.reason: a celebration or a happy feeling in the story; no celebration happens in the game -- the draft's notes: everything but the marked effects is story only

o1.name: Outcome A
o1.text: The village works hard in the cool morning and finishes by noon. The celebration lasts all afternoon. The elders sing the old songs, the young sing the new ones, and somewhere in the middle they start singing each other's.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) starts a song, and it turns into three songs, and a dance. The work starts late and finishes at sunset, in the heat, with a lot of complaining. The celebration is short and everyone falls asleep early. It was still a good day.
